title: Counterfactual decision support for pre-trip electric vehicle charging: range estimation, state-of-charge-aware energy planning and rule-based advice (code and results)
description: Open-source repository providing a fully reproducible implementation of a pre-trip EV charging decision-support pipeline: an EV range estimator selected by nested group cross-validation within the training vehicles and evaluated on untouched test vehicles, vehicle-specific efficiency and state-of-charge-aware energy requirement, charging plans at SAE J1772 charger power levels, DiCE counterfactuals under stated plausibility constraints, and a trip-level evaluation on public datasets.
